sourceDocuments.title: Doctrine of Locus Standi in Public Interest Litigation
sourceDocuments.text: In Fawehinmi v Akilu, the Supreme Court liberalized the restrictive doctrine of locus standi regarding criminal prosecutions for murder, recognizing the communal obligation of every citizen to advocate the enforcement of the rule of law.
